result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **Dropbox Sign, DocuSign, and PandaDoc** are the three e-signature platforms I'd shortlist.

My recommendation depends on whether you simply need customers to sign documents or want a more complete system for quotes, contracts, approvals and sales.

Here’s how I'd compare the leading options.

## Best e-signature platforms compared

| Software | Best for | My verdict |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Dropbox Sign | Simple contracts and agreements | Best for simplicity |
| DocuSign | Professional business signing | Best all-rounder |
| PandaDoc | Quotes, proposals and contracts | Best for sales |
| SignWell | Freelancers and small teams | Best budget-friendly option |
| Zoho Sign | Businesses using Zoho apps | Best ecosystem integration |
| Adobe Acrobat Sign | PDF-heavy businesses | Best for PDF workflows |


### My top three

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign — best for straightforward signing**

- Easy to use.
- Reusable document templates.
- Signing audit trails.
- Good for employment contracts, client agreements and supplier documents.

Indicative entry pricing: around \$15/month.

[Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign — best all-rounder**

- Widely recognised by customers and suppliers.
- Strong document tracking and audit trails.
- Lots of integrations.
- More advanced signing workflows.

Indicative entry pricing: around \$11/month.

[Visit DocuSign UK](https://www.docusign.com/en-gb)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc — best for growing businesses**

- Create professional proposals and contracts.
- Add pricing tables and payment options.
- Track when customers open documents.
- Collect signatures in the same workflow.

Indicative entry pricing: around \$19/user/month annually.

[Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

Prices are indicative US-dollar advertised starting prices, not confirmed UK quotes. Plans, limits and billing terms vary. [helpcompare.com](https://helpcompare.com/e-signature/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.helprange.com](https://www.helprange.com/e-signature-comparison?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dupple.com](https://dupple.com/learn/best-e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## One more option worth considering in the UK

**Signable** is worth a look if you want a UK-based specialist.

- UK-focused service.
- Unlimited users on its account-based plans.
- Pay-as-you-go option for occasional signing.
- Useful for businesses sending relatively small numbers of contracts.

[Visit Signable](https://www.signable.co.uk/)\. [www.sortlist.co.uk](https://www.sortlist.co.uk/blog/software/e-signature-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd choose

- **Just need customers to sign PDFs\:** Dropbox Sign.
- **Want a recognised, professional solution\:** DocuSign.
- **Send quotations and proposals regularly\:** PandaDoc.
- **Want a UK-focused provider\:** Signable.

One important point: electronic signatures are generally legally valid for commercial agreements in England and Wales, although certain documents have additional formalities. [www.sortlist.co.uk](https://www.sortlist.co.uk/blog/software/e-signature-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
